newsitem.title: USA: ADM to develop soy product as vitamin supplement.
newsitem.headline: ADM to develop soy product as vitamin supplement.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Thursday it is developing a new product, isoflavone concentrate, derived from the soybean and intended for the vitamin and supplement market.

Some animal and human studies suggest that soy/isoflavones may inhibit bone loss or may stimulate bone formation, according to abstracts of studies presented at an international symposium on soybeans.
A substantial number of additional studies are underway to confirm these results, ADM said in a statement.
ADM said it has started pilot production and plans to have commercial quantities available in a range of concentrations by early 1998.
